Syria
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Amman, Jordan.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade or at the entry.
Regular biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade.
Service/Official biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade.
Diplomatic biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Belgrade.
Citizens of the Syrian Arab Republic are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Amman, Jordan.
